channel.title: Violations Watch: Ethiopia
channel.description: New incidents reported in Ethiopia. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Drone strike near Badme on the Ethiopia–Eritrea border wounds at least four civilians; Tigray's North Western Zone bans gatherings (DNE Africa)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Badme, Tigray, Ethiopia. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike. Reported casualties: 4 injured. Disputed or caveats: Perpetrator not stated in the report. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1179

item.title: Six people killed in a suspected clan militia attack near the Ethiopia–Kenya border (Addis Standard)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Ethiopia. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Suspected clan militia. Reported casualties: 6 killed. 3 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0917

item.title: Armed Oromo militia reportedly kills eight Somali civilians in southern Ethiopia near the Kenya border
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Southern Ethiopia (Kenya border). Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Armed Oromo militia (blamed by local authorities). Reported casualties: 8 killed. Disputed or caveats: Attribution by local authorities; circumstances not independently verified. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0626

item.title: Clan militia attack on Waba village, Somali region / Dawa Zone near the Kenyan border: eight killed, including a father, mother and children
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Waba village, Dawa Zone, Somali, Ethiopia. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Clan militia. Reported casualties: 8 killed. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Social-media and regional outlet reports; attackers not named. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0743

item.title: More than 50,000 displaced by deadly clashes on the Oromia–Benishangul-Gumuz border (Al Jazeera)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Oromia–Benishangul-Gumuz border, Ethiopia. Types: Forced displacement. Alleged perpetrator: Parties to border clashes. 6 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0337

item.title: Around 30 displaced Amhara civilians reported killed in drone strikes; further civilian killings reported in South Gondar
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Amhara (incl. South Gondar), Ethiopia. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike, Forced displacement. Alleged perpetrator: Ethiopian forces (alleged drone strikes). Reported casualties: 29-30 killed. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Mainly social-media and advocacy sources. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0220

item.title: Armed attack in Assosa Zone, Benishangul-Gumuz (5 Nov): 52–105 killed reported; civilian and militia breakdown disputed
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Assosa Zone, Benishangul-Gumuz, Ethiopia. Types: Mass atrocity / genocide, Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified armed men. Reported casualties: 52-105 killed. Disputed or caveats: One count: 21 civilians, 31 militia; totals disputed. 7 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0046

item.title: Gunmen kill at least 34 Orthodox Christian civilians in Endeto, Robe district, Arsi zone, Oromia; 40 bodies reported buried in a mass grave
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Endeto, Robe district, Arsi zone, Oromia, Ethiopia. Types: Mass atrocity / genocide, Killing of civilians, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified gunmen. Reported casualties: 34-40 killed. Disputed or caveats: Mainly advocacy and social-media sources. 4 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0004

item.title: Drone strike kills 12 civilians collecting grain in Tigray; ACLED suspects the Ethiopian army
item.description: Unverified lead (Critical priority). Tigray, Ethiopia. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Ethiopian National Defence Force (suspected, per ACLED). Reported casualties: 12 killed. Disputed or caveats: Perpetrator suspected, not confirmed. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0002
